DeepSeek alternatives

DeepSeek: Free chat with DeepSeek's open-weight reasoning models. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI chatbots and assistants from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1ChatGPTOpenAI's everyday assistant: chat, files, pictures, voice and agents that browse and act for you.Free plan
  2. 2ClaudeAnthropic's assistant, careful writing, long documents and serious coding help.Free plan
  3. 3GeminiGoogle's assistant, plugged into Search, Gmail, Docs and your Android phone.Free plan
  4. 4GrokxAI's assistant, with what people are posting on X right now in reach.Free plan
  5. 5Microsoft CopilotMicrosoft's assistant across Windows, Edge and the Office apps.Free plan
  6. 6Meta AIMeta's assistant inside WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, or on its own.Free
  7. 7Le ChatMistral's fast European assistant, with web search, documents and code.Free plan
  8. 8Qwen ChatAlibaba's Qwen models to chat with, text, images, video and code.Free
  9. 9KimiMoonshot AI's assistant, known for reading very long documents and agentic work.Free plan
  10. 10PoeOne app for most of the big models, plus bots other people have built on them.Free plan
  11. 11Character.AIChat and role-play with characters, made by you or by the community.Free plan
  12. 12PiA warm, conversational companion that's good at talking things through.Free
  13. 13HuggingChatChat with the best open models, free, in Hugging Face's own app.Free
  14. 14Duck.aiDuckDuckGo's private AI chat: popular models, conversations kept anonymous.Free

Free to start: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini.
